findings.title: Homepage travel ranking mixes incompatible earn-rate units
findings.observation: The travel shortlist sorts raw travel earn rates despite source comments noting per-AED, per-AED-10 and per-USD units. Hidden figures do not make the ranking comparable.
findings.recommendation: Remove the ranking claim or use approved deterministic normalisation with explicit assumptions.

findings.title: Calculator readiness, reset and bounds need a functional pass
findings.observation: Local Chrome reproduced the documented 3.49% default changing to 3.25% after choosing DIB and then Use the default. An input of 21 exceeded the field's maximum of 20 (HTML validity false) but still updated the result. Source also shows uneven readiness/no-JavaScript treatment; no arithmetic accuracy claim is made by this reset/bounds test.
findings.recommendation: Define default versus custom behaviour, enforce bounds in state/computation and add consistent no-JavaScript/readiness states.

findings.title: Offer freshness wording exceeds static delivery guarantees
findings.observation: Deal filtering uses build-time Date.now(). The weekly expiry monitor opens/updates issues, not a redeployment. This does not prove an expired offer is currently visible; it cannot guarantee 'live on the day you visit'.
findings.recommendation: Agree expiry-day/timezone handling and safe rebuild/runtime expiry treatment; match copy to actual verification.

findings.title: Analytics needs a privacy-safe reporting contract
findings.observation: The standard GA tag is present; review-only preparation is separate. No monthly human-only unique-user result or sensitive-data leak is demonstrated by this review. Owner left Google's account settings unchanged.
findings.recommendation: Do not change account settings without approval. Review route/action allowlists and URL sanitisation before adding events; never transmit salary, spend or free text. Known-bot exclusion is not proof every remaining visitor is human.

findings.title: Homepage reporting arrives late in ordinary scrolling
findings.observation: At 390×844 live, Fresh from the desk begins around 6,414px down, versus Tools around 2,024px. Direct shortcuts exist. Its publication hierarchy is a design judgement, not a broken-access claim.
findings.recommendation: Test reporting immediately after a concise arrival, then task doors, offers and travel coverage. Preserve native scrolling.

findings.title: Reading layouts stack text before visual evidence
findings.observation: Article routes provide photos after prose/sources. Several text-led heading layers precede the body; some breadcrumbs repeat News. These are not missing-image findings.
findings.recommendation: Lead with the answer/key facts; position relevant imagery or data near the section it helps, keeping full sources and one contents control.

findings.title: Images need defined roles, not one universal size
findings.observation: Hotels repeats the featured photograph in its first listing. Compact News geometry is corrected in the held preview. Liv portrait art is approximately 174×281px at 390px and contained, not stretched; its visual balance is a judgement.
findings.recommendation: Define feature/listing/product/evidence media roles, separate credit tracks and avoid adjacent duplicate photography.

findings.title: Some discovery labels overstate their actual scope
findings.observation: Guide topic controls navigate rather than filter. Bank search submits to general site search. Deal filter state is not shareable.
findings.recommendation: Use honest Explore labels or genuine scoped filters; retain selected views in privacy-safe URLs where useful.

findings.title: Archive and expanded-calculator transitions lose context
findings.observation: Salary history receives dates/headlines/bands but no detail/source/current-offer link. CardValueScenario links to bare /calculator/. Existing Finder/Compare and salary context fixes must not be duplicated or described as absent.
findings.recommendation: Link archived evidence where available; explain estimate-basis changes or hand off only justified totals without inventing category allocations.

findings.title: Long-form navigation should converge on the current pattern
findings.observation: Card jump navigation and reading contents differ; long trust-policy layouts lack equivalent contents. Recent programme navigation fixes are already present.
findings.recommendation: Extend one accessible current-section pattern where useful, without adding a competing menu.

findings.title: Motion must react to live preference changes
findings.observation: Homepage scripts sample prefers-reduced-motion on initialisation. CSS alone may leave reveal states or animation work on a live preference change. Runtime-change testing is pending.
findings.recommendation: Cancel observers/RAF/seeking and reveal final states immediately. No gallery autoplay, scroll lock or animated financial values.

findings.title: Navigation taxonomy needs small completeness fixes
findings.observation: Interest calculator is available in mobile Tools but not desktop/footer equivalent. Home directory omits News and Hotels.
findings.recommendation: Align task-based navigation and parent journeys rather than adding more top-level choices.
